bayesian_identifiability.interpretation: Both executed cells fail on theta/beta (mean_identifiability), not compile. The dropped column is the near-empty off-treatment basis (ob_ld[0]; OFF≈0). Remaining poorly mixed coordinates sit on strain×time bases: few studies identify strain-specific growth once ZeroSum study effects and the shared time spline are present. Doubling draws/tune did not meet ESS≥400. Parameterization and thresholds were not changed to chase reliability.

parameterization.mean: QR: prior on theta = R* beta; beta = Rinv theta; pivoted QR drops rank-deficient columns
parameterization.random_effects: non-centered ZeroSumNormal study/animal intercept and slope (identifies mean via fixed effects)
parameterization.residual: OU without a free white-noise nugget (documented non-identifiability vs sigma_p)

coverage_increments.denominators_note: Coverage uses study-balanced means unless noted. Increment n is per-animal consecutive-visit series.
coverage_increments.mechanism: New-study draws add a shared study intercept/slope plus animal and OU terms. Increment SD is the mean, over draws, of per-animal consecutive-visit SDs; that includes the new study slope, so pred increment SD can exceed the observed within-animal increment SD. HierarchicalCovariance often parks sigma_m at its optimizer floor (train OOF, not a test-calibrated nugget). Wide predictive intervals then overcover. Widths were not shrunk to match exposed test coverage.
not_done: No residual scale was multiplied to hit nominal 80/95 coverage on test.
No increment-ratio target was used as a tuning objective.
Validation pre-study packs were not written by the research executor; compound-holdout coverage is a second exposed split and was not used to calibrate.

nested_seeds.hash_note: Target-manifest hashes are STUDYID-set hashes. Training seeds reshuffle which of those IDs are validation vs test. Dataset seeds change the outcomes behind the same generator labels.
